thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager to Maya — elevated KV eviction rate + rising p99 for hosted inference (10m sustained). Pager: Maya
Maya: saw the alert at 04:02 UTC. Pulling graphs now. p50 ok, p95/p99 up ~2x. Starting triage.
Tomas: joining. Any recent config flips in batching or quantization?
Lin: we rolled out batching backpressure tuning to staging at 01:08 and promoted a quantized kernel flag to experimental at 02:30. No direct prod deploys AFAIK, but router-sample 2% to experimental was enabled at 03:45.
Maya: rolling back router sampling first to stop blast radius: `redwoodctl router update --name router-sample --set experimental=0`.
infra-bot: Router sampling rollback submitted at 04:05 UTC.
Asha: I'm pulling logs for 5xx and KV misses: `SELECT tenant_id, sum(case when status>=500 then 1 else 0 end) as errors, sum(case when kv_miss then 1 else 0 end) as kv_misses FROM request_logs WHERE ts>now()-interval '20 minutes' GROUP BY tenant_id`.
Nikhil: I'll open a live dashboard and pin it to the channel. Also raising infra manifest: KV pod eviction spikes in pool hot-partition.
Maya: immediate mitigation: 1) rollback router sampling (done), 2) scale KV hot-partition + restart pods to clear thrash (Nikhil), 3) temporarily disable experimental quant kernel flag globally (Lin), 4) pin high-SLA tenants to dedicated variant (Tomas).
Tomas: pinning tenant-alpha and tenant-edge: `redwoodctl route set --tenant tenant-alpha --model stable-dedicated --force`.
Lin: disabling quant flag in config and rolling out to runtime-prod at 04:11: `kubectl set env deployment/runtime-prod QUANT_EXPERIMENT=false`.
infra-bot: KV pool scale request accepted: `hot-partition` -> 56GB, rolling restart started at 04:09 UTC.
Maya: thanks. Asha, any early customer impact numbers?
Asha: preliminary: tenant-alpha 5xx peaked at 4.7% (10:03-10:12 window), tenant-edge 2.1%, tenant-internal 0.9%. Mostly transient timeouts, no data loss.
Maya: good. Nikhil, watch for cache warmup effects after restart. Run warmup script: `./ops/warm_kv.sh hot-partition --concurrency 6`.
Nikhil: warmup running. Observability shows KV miss rate drop after warmup, p99 improving.
Asha: CS holding message drafted: "We're investigating increased errors impacting inference latency. Mitigations underway; we'll share updates in 30m." Sending to affected accounts now.
Tomas: root-cause quick hypothesis: quant kernel changed serialized fingerprint for KV keys -> lookup mismatch -> miss storm -> eviction churn -> higher latencies. Also batching backpressure tweak amplified request bursts into hot keys.
Lin: that matches traces I see — many misses for keys that should be hot. I can reproduce locally by toggling the kernel fingerprint flag.
Maya: good repro. Forensics: capture kernel metadata before/after and diff key hashing outputs. Priya? (Priya not on call.) Asha: I'll collect tenant traces and paste example spans.
Asha: trace sample (abbreviated):
```
span: lookup_kv key=kernel_meta_v2 fingerprint=0x9a7f -> miss
span: fetch_backend -> 200ms
span: write_kv -> eviction
```
Maya: okay. Action items and owners (add to tracker):
- Disable experimental quant kernel promotion to any traffic channels until KV-compat CI exists (owner: Lin, due 2026-04-02).
- Add KV key-compatibility tests to quant CI with synthetic kernel variants (owner: Tomas, due 2026-04-06).
- Add an alert for sudden change in kv_miss_ratio + eviction_rate correlation (owner: Nikhil, due 2026-03-30).
- Update runbook for cache-resize to include immediate warmup and tenant-routing note (owner: Maya, due 2026-03-28).
- Customer communication follow-up for tenant-alpha (owner: Asha, due 2026-03-27).

infra-bot: Created incident board: https://tracker.redwood.internal/INC-1919191919
Maya: scheduling postmortem: today 15:30 UTC, 50m. Owner: Tomas + Lin. Please add agenda items: timeline, RCA, tests, deployment gating, customer impact, follow-ups.
Tomas: I'll draft the postmortem doc and include the kernel fingerprint spec. Link placeholder: https://docs.redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-1919191919
Lin: I'll own the CI test PR and immediate guard to block any quant kernel flag flips to production channels. ETA PR by 2026-03-31.
Nikhil: I'll implement the composite alert for kv_miss_ratio x eviction_rate and add a dashboard for tenant-level 5xx spikes. ETA 2026-03-30.
Asha: sending customer follow-ups now and will coordinate postmortem summary with CS templates.
Maya: handoff note: I'm on-call til 12:00 UTC. If anything regresses, page me at channel. After the postmortem meeting we'll consolidate action items and close the incident.
Tomas: quick follow-up: we should add a canary compatibility check that runs a mini workload against KV after any kernel metadata change. I'll prototype that test.
Maya: agreed. No objections to freezing kernel-fingerprint changes in sampling/routing until CI is in place?
Lin: no objections. Will add a temporary gate.
oncall-bot: Incident status changed -> MITIGATED at 04:34 UTC. Please publish postmortem and update tracker.
Maya: excellent work. We'll keep this thread for any late observations and move formal notes into the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
